summary.text: Alma Allen is a member of the Texas House of Representatives, first elected on November 2, 2004. Before that she served over 10 years on the State Board of Education and spent 39 years in the Houston Independent School District.

paragraphs.text: Allen began her career as a teacher at Parker and Grimes Elementary Schools, then became assistant principal at Foster Elementary and principal of Peck Elementary, Windsor Village Vanguard Magnet School and G.B.M. Turner Elementary.
She retired from the Houston Independent School District after 39 years and later was an adjunct professor at Texas Southern University and Prairie View A&M University.
She holds a Bachelor of Science and a Master of Education from Texas Southern University and a Doctorate of Education in curriculum and instruction from the University of Houston.
She and her husband, Lawrence A. Allen, Sr., have two children and five grandchildren.
